comments.text: This was very informative, Thank-you. But for some reason I'm running into complex issues every step of the way. (I've never filed a patent before, nor would I consider myself computer savvy). So, my issue is, when it comes to uploading and converting documents into the right format, I got all the diagrams converted & then realized that although it's not necessary to have diagrams labeled with words for provisional, it will be much easier if I did it now vs later. I realized that right when I thought I was finished. 😭So NOW I have to go BACK & redo all the converted pictures I've spent hours on, just for contingency. Along with having an issue downloading just the basic PPA form so I can fill it out. I've tried looking it up & opening on multiple word software, but it won't let me edit it for some reason.😭😭😭😭😭😭
